purpose: Undo refused after another page changed the run (compare-and-set)
expected_value: rendered "Can't undo — something changed" (or "another run is in progress"); row stays as written by the other page
environment: merged main, production build (npm run build; PW_PROD=1 npx playwright test), local next start on http://localhost:3000, projects chromium + mobile (iPhone 13 WebKit)
coverage_note: The pinned oracle is the two-page case; AC-TAP-12 asserts it as "another run is in progress" (two pages) and "something changed" (compare-and-set); both refuse and leave the row as the other page wrote it.
